SELECT M.ESNTL_ID AS uniqId , B.BIZR_SEQ AS bizrSeq , B.BIZRNO AS bizrno , M.CMPNY_NM AS cmpnyNm , M.ENTRPRS_MBER_ID AS entrprsmberId , M.APPLCNT_IHIDNUM2 AS applcntIhidnum2 FROM COMTNENTRPRSMBER M INNER JOIN COMTNENTRPRSBIZR B ON M.ENTRPRS_MBER_ID = B.ENTRPRS_MBER_ID AND B.USE_AT = 'Y' WHERE 1 = 1
AND REPLACE(B.BIZRNO, '-', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(#{searchBusinessNo}, '-', ''), '%')
AND M.CMPNY_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchBusinessName}, '%')
ORDER BY M.SBSCRB_DE DESC, M.ENTRPRS_MBER_ID ASC, B.BIZR_SEQ ASC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM COMTNENTRPRSMBER M INNER JOIN COMTNENTRPRSBIZR B ON M.ENTRPRS_MBER_ID = B.ENTRPRS_MBER_ID AND B.USE_AT = 'Y' WHERE 1 = 1
AND REPLACE(B.BIZRNO, '-', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(#{searchBusinessNo}, '-', ''), '%')
AND M.CMPNY_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchBusinessName}, '%')

SELECT M.ESNTL_ID AS uniqId , B.BIZR_SEQ AS bizrSeq , B.BIZRNO AS bizrno , M.CMPNY_NM AS cmpnyNm , M.ENTRPRS_MBER_ID AS entrprsmberId , M.APPLCNT_IHIDNUM AS applcntIhidnum , M.APPLCNT_IHIDNUM2 AS applcntIhidnum2 , M.HOMETAX_PASSWORD AS hometaxPassword FROM COMTNENTRPRSMBER M INNER JOIN COMTNENTRPRSBIZR B ON M.ENTRPRS_MBER_ID = B.ENTRPRS_MBER_ID WHERE B.BIZR_SEQ = #{value} AND B.USE_AT = 'Y'
